## <img src="https://api.iconify.design/lucide/user-round.svg?color=%2300A068&width=24" align="absmiddle" alt=""/> About

I'm Prashant Kumar, Founder & CEO of Bibha AI Labs, an AI-powered workforce platform. I started Bibha in mid-2024 to build the infrastructure for a workforce where humans and AI agents work side by side.

## <img src="https://api.iconify.design/lucide/briefcase.svg?color=%2300A068&width=24" align="absmiddle" alt=""/> Experience

More than a decade as a hands-on engineer and R&D leader, across domains that rarely overlap:

- Retail tech at **Target**
- Industrial IoT and SCADA systems
- Autonomous vehicles at **Harman**, including Daimler truck testing
- Fleet management, most recently as Head of Engineering at **Azuga** through its acquisition by Bridgestone

I started working with LLMs in early 2019, well before they were mainstream. That early conviction is what led me to found Bibha.

## <img src="https://api.iconify.design/lucide/graduation-cap.svg?color=%2300A068&width=24" align="absmiddle" alt=""/> Education

- **Bachelor of Engineering**, Computer Science (2014)
- **MBA**, Global Business, University of Western Australia
- **Executive Management Development Programme**, Business Analytics, Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode
